re-awakening-cannon-fodder-with-stronges:
Ethan, a high school student that died alongside his bully transmigrated into another world.
Ethan awakened in a parallel world, one where supernatural talents determined your worth, and the talentless serve as expendable cannon fodder.
Born talentless in this new world, Ethan finds himself assigned as cannon fodder against the monster hordes that threaten humanity.
But his death in the previous world seemed to have granted him a supreme Talent.
Follow the story of Ethan as he awakens the strongest talent and strives to become the world's Strongest.

reincarnated-as-a-baby-my-cry-is-a-drago:
Reincarnated as a baby who was in his mother’s womb for a hundred years, the moment Lin Xuan was born, the whole world was shocked.
When he took his first breath, he gathered all the purple qi from 30,000 miles east. He was dubbed the Saint Child by others.
When he let out his first cry, it helped all of the cultivators around him break through their limits.
When he first opened his eyes, his parents mastered the Divine Eyes technique.
When he first moved his fingers, he tore open a crack in space. It was the Devastating Finger.
When he took his first step, cracks formed on the crust of the earth. It was the Chaotic Eight Steps.
When he first spoke, first ate, and first showered…
His Ancestor praised, “He’s the pride of our family.”
The Holy Maiden argued, “He’s mine!”
The Empress announced, “I’m willing to wait until he’s an adult!”
Buddda’s apprentice cursed, “Why am I meditating here? I can break through just by being close to him!”
By the time the baby grew into a child, he was already invincible.
shrouding-the-heavens:
In the cold and dark depths of the universe, nine massive dragon corpses pull an ancient bronze coffin, existing since time immemorial.
This is an incredibly shocking image captured by a space probe in the desolate universe.
Nine dragons pulling the coffin—have they returned to Ancient Times, or have they arrived at the Paramita of the Starry Sky?
A vast world of Immortal Heroes, bizarre and extraordinary, endlessly mysterious. Blood boils like a volcano, passion surges like a vast sea, desire is as boundless as the Abyss...
Climbing the Heavenly Road, walking while singing, a mere gesture can cover the sky.
starting-out-as-the-god-of-beasts:
Roy was destined to be useless.
A failure of a student but a professional gamer who conquered every video game his hands touched.
While everyone around him was successful in their life, he was the shame of his family.
That fate ended when Roy died.
But death was merely a relocation.
Roy awakens transmigrated into ‘Arkan Unlimited’, a cosmic game where transmigrators play the roles of deities.
Placed on a strict ten-year execution timer, he starts at the absolute bottom: a Level 0 False God.
Inheriting the fractured domain of the God of Beasts, Roy must navigate a brutal world of deceit, darkness, and forbidden proxy wars.
To survive, he must stay hidden from the omnipotent True Gods, walk the ruthless path of ascension, and forcibly claim the souls of beastmen and monsters alike.
The once isolated video gamer is dead. In his place stands Varanus—the God of Beasts and Men, Who Shall Devour All.
Welcome to the League of Gods.
taiyi-dao-fruit:
Standing before you is the Quicklime Martial Saint, the founder of the Taiyang Fist, the Flower Folding Master of Dinghu, Half-step Master Invincible Under Heaven, the First Sword of Xuanmen, the Judicial God, and Taiyi.
...
After the end of the Dharma, a time of grand corruption descends, the world devoid of spiritual essence, and the system of Dao fruits takes precedence.
Embracing Dao fruits, ascending step by step, thereby possessing the power of gods and saints, transcending the ordinary to achieve holiness.
'Just like this,' Jiang Li said while summoning a dog, 'Heavenly Dog, bite him.'
the-almighty-dragon-rider-returns: Since the death of his parents in the war, Reynold mindset changed as he vowed to get into the riders Academy. His mission is to graduate at the academy and begin his journey to solve the mystery behind his parents death and reclaim his family property.
the-clan-master-cant-possibly-be-a-morta:
“Sect Master Uncle is just a mortal, who just happens to have his own ‘billion’ interpretations of various spells.”
Atop Misty Peak, the sect’s senior disciple was educating the new beginners.
At that moment, Sect Leader Ye Feng, holding a blade of grass, waved it gently, and a fierce Sword Qi split the sky in two, revealing a dark spatial rift that was difficult to heal, frightening the gods above.
The new disciple pointed at the sky, shocked, “And you told me the Sect Leader is just a mortal?”
the-darkness-system-rise-of-the-broken-s:
I died once reaching for a woman whose face I can no longer remember.
Reborn into the Vorn Dynasty—a brutal family that rules over thirteen worlds—I was supposed to be a genius. Instead, I was declared broken. My soul is fractured, my memories are gone, and my own siblings view me as nothing more than a lamb for the slaughter.
But the cracks in my soul aren't empty. They're filled with something ancient.
[SYSTEM INITIALIZATION...]
[SOUL INTEGRITY: 47%]
[THE DARKNESS CALLS]
With the power to crush my enemies with gravity and fry their nerves with lightning, I will carve a path through the blood of my rivals. I will unearth the mystery of my past death, reclaim the woman haunting my dreams, and tear down the empires that dare to stand in my way.
But power isn't the only thing I crave.
In a universe where betrayal is the only constant, I find solace in the arms of those brave enough to love a monster. From the icy assassin sent to kill me, to the time-bending beauty who has watched me die seventeen times before—I will collect their hearts, their bodies, and their absolute devotion.
They call me broken. They call me weak.
They just haven't seen the darkness inside me yet.…
the-demon-lord-is-an-angel:
This is the story of Kir, who has to thwart the will of Heaven, Hell, and his parents in order to survive, protect the people he loves, and achieve happiness.
He just has to make it through life at a magical academy, avoid dying, and survive to find his birth mother, the lost Daughter of Heaven. Or be forced to take his place at the side of his father, a Duke of Hell bent on destroying the way things are.
It's a lot to handle for a quiet, brooding angel boy.
Fortunately, he has company. A succubus, a foxkin girl, and a half-angel boy to start. And Kir has his own secret: this isn't his first go at life.
the-extra-reincarnated-into-the-royal-fa:
In the world of his favorite novel, Ryan was reincarnated as the character Extra, whom no one pays attention to. Not once, but twice.
In a world where the Paths to Divinity define your status, he is in the body of the most useless. The scorned member of the Royal Family, who is not even considered in the fight for the throne, whom his brother and father want to kill.
Even so, armed with knowledge of the past and the future, he decides to face his present with determination and forge his own legend, becoming a Walker of a hidden path—one that may allow him to overcome them all... or devour himself.
Perhaps either option would be his salvation in a world that has fallen into an apocalypse because of the “Kazaks”, beasts of unprecedented power that threaten to destroy all.
But he vows not to rest until he achieves his revenge against the protagonists and understands the mysteries surrounding this world.
Follow the story of the despised Ninth Prince who rises in the world and becomes a true Devourer of Paths.
the-hero-became-a-succubus-and-the-only-:
Kanae Toyomi is an effeminate 18 year old guy fresh out of high school, who uses his soft features and crossdresses to make extra money on the side. One night, through a series of accidents, he is mistakenly sent into a fantasy world with RPG elements.
The problem?
He is sent there as a succubus, and the only way to level up might have piqued his curiosity.

the-sea-queen-of-1985:
The apocalypse arrived, and Han Xiaorui awakened a Water Ability.
While fishing at sea, she encountered a storm, was pulled into a marine black hole, and lost consciousness.
When she woke up again, she found she had transmigrated to a parallel world in the year 1985.
Right from the start, she's facing a divorce!
And she's being told to leave with nothing!
In your dreams!
Han Xiaorui is someone who dares to fight fierce sea beasts. Would she be afraid of a cheating husband and a vicious, misogynistic mother-in-law?
After a successful divorce, Han Xiaorui brought her sister, who was working as a migrant laborer, over to help take care of her child.
She used her Water Ability to go angling and fishing at sea.
Red sea bream filled her holds to bursting!
Large lobsters filled her holds to bursting!
Big Yellow Fish and small yellow croakers filled her holds to bursting!
Giant mud crabs and swimming crabs filled her holds to bursting!
...
Every time, she would set out with an empty boat and return with a full hold, becoming known far and wide as the “Sea Queen.”
From time to time, her fishing nets would also pull up surveillance devices secretly placed by foreign countries.…

the-villain-professors-second-chance:
Draven is a magic professor in a fantasy world. He is also an earl, notorious for his evil deeds and mistakes since youth. His downfall is due to a curse that hinders his intellectual potential and his talents. Eventually, he becomes a villain, losing everything he holds dear: his siblings, fiancée, house, domain, and more. After a miserable death, he reincarnates in the modern world as Dravis Granger.
In his new life, he grows up to be a highly intellectual individual oblivious towards his previous life, becoming a young professor in mechanical engineering and a researcher. However, he harbors a strange obsession with creating a game, fueled by vivid imaginings of another world. This obsession leads him to develop a game that mirrors his previous life. Upon completing his virtual reality world, he regains his past memories. Overwhelmed by intense emotions—rage, sadness, and the realization of his past ugliness—he suffers a fatal heart attack.
In his final moments, he hears a voice, seemingly from the world itself, offering him a chance to return to his original fantasy world. However, he would only retain the memories of his modern life, not those of his first life’s mistakes.…
the-wicked-female-is-wild-and-scheming-l:
Luna Sutton was unfortunately blown to death in the apocalypse, and when she opened her eyes, she was almost tackled by an incredibly handsome man.
However, the way the man looked at her was off, full of disgust, disdain, and a dark, violent aura.
Luna Sutton curled her lips: You're the one coming at me, what do those eyes mean?
As memories came flooding in, she broke into a cold sweat. Had the original Luna forcibly married this Beast Husband?
She wasn't about to take the blame for that!
Luna Sutton kicked the man away and slipped off.
It turned out she had entered a certain beast world game, becoming the ugly, despised clown disliked by men and women of all ages.
The original Luna was lazy, gluttonous, vicious, and incredibly ugly, making people sick.
Despite everything, she didn't have any self-awareness, relying on the fact that the tribe's leader was her father, seizing whatever she wanted and causing trouble, with an extreme crush on others.
Her leader father assigned her five top-tier Beast Husbands.
These five Beast Husbands abhorred her to the extreme, looking at her as if she were a pile of excrement.…
ultra-gene-evolution-system:
In the year 2147, humanity no longer fights with guns or machines alone — they fight with genes.
After the discovery of Primal Gene Fragments hidden within mysterious dimensional rifts, scientists unlocked the ability to evolve human DNA beyond its natural limits. The world entered the era of Gene Evolution. Cities became fortresses, corporations became gene empires, and the strong devoured the weak.
But evolution is expensive. Only the elite can afford powerful gene upgrades.
Kai Ren, a poor slum scavenger living at the edge of Mega City Helios, survives by collecting scraps from abandoned rift zones. During one dangerous expedition, he discovers a forbidden relic buried inside a collapsed alien ruin.
Instead of killing him, it binds to his DNA.
[Ultra Gene Evolution System Activated]
Unlike normal gene users who must buy or steal genetic upgrades, Kai gains something impossible — a system that allows infinite evolution.
Devour mutant beasts.
Absorb alien DNA.
Break the limits of human biology.
Each evolution pushes him closer to something unknown… something no longer human.
But Kai soon discovers the truth.
The rifts were not natural.
They were doors.…
